sentences.en: In this paper, we show that the isometry between the unit spheres of certain normed space and its dual space can be extended to a real linear isometry on the whole space.

sentences.en: The space M is determined up to isometry by this property, and is called the completion of M . The completion of M can be constructed as a set of equivalence classes of Cauchy sequences in M .
